title: APAC Genie - Transactional Banking: Trade & Supply Chain Finance
description: Ask about trade finance issuance and outstanding by product and corridor, supply chain finance programme health, trade operations turnaround and document discrepancies, and trade-flow opportunities for SMBC's APAC clients. Figures are USD unless you ask for local currency; periods follow the Japanese fiscal year (Apr-Mar). Client names roll up to client groups; data is synthetic and as of 30 Sep 2026.
general_instructions:
- Fiscal year runs 1 April to 31 March. FY2026 = Apr 2026 to Mar 2027. Q1 = Apr-Jun, Q2 = Jul-Sep, Q3 = Oct-Dec, Q4 = Jan-Mar. H1 = Apr-Sep, H2 = Oct-Mar.
- "This year" / "YTD" means fiscal year to date; "latest month" means September 2026 unless the user names a month.
- Default currency is USD. Use local currency only when asked.
- "Client" or "group" without qualification means the client group (global parent); "entity" means the individual legal entity. When asked "which clients", answer at group level with the top 20 and show the coverage office.
- "APAC" means all APAC booking entities. "Country" means booking country unless the user says "risk country", "client country" or "HQ country". "Global" or "including Japan" means use the regional (JP/APAC/EMEA/AMER) dimension.
- "Japanese corporates" means Is Japanese Corporate = true. "Strategic clients" means Relationship Tier = Strategic.
- Balance-type measures (deposits, exposure, RWA, ECL, scores, headcount) are point-in-time month-end values: group by month when a question spans several months; never sum them across months. Use the Average measure when the user says "average".
- Year-on-year compares the same fiscal period in the prior fiscal year.
- Prefer measures from the metric views; use MEASURE() syntax.
- If the question is ambiguous between two metric views, ask one clarifying question rather than guessing.
- Today = 30 Sep 2026 (H1 FY2026 close); never use CURRENT_DATE() or NOW(). "Last N days" = Date BETWEEN DATE'2026-09-30' - (N-1) AND DATE'2026-09-30'. Client names have no value dictionary: match them with LIKE '%name%'.
- Views: mv_tb_trade_finance = trade-finance issuance, fees / fee yield, tenor and outstanding by product, goods corridor, commodity and expiry quarter; mv_trade_operations = LC document checks, discrepancies, turnaround vs the 24-hour SLA; mv_tb_scf = SCF programmes and suppliers; mv_trade_corridors = external corridor statistics, SMBC share, clients without a trade product; mv_tb_payments = payments (suppliers paid).
- Fiscal periods: filter or group the `Fiscal Year` / `Fiscal Half` / `Fiscal Quarter` dimensions by their labels ('FY2025' = Apr 2025-Mar 2026, 'FY2026' = Apr-Sep 2026 to date, 'FY2026-H1', 'FY2026-Q2'); never rebuild fiscal years from `Month` ranges. Point-in-time measures (Outstanding USD, Live Instruments, Active Trade Clients, SCF limit / outstanding / utilisation / supplier counts) need ONE `Month` or `Is Latest Month` (today = Sep 2026).
- Trade `Corridor` / `Corridor From` / `Corridor To` = goods origin -> destination (CN->VN = goods from China into Vietnam; import LCs into Vietnam = `Corridor To` = 'VN'); `Booking Country` = where SMBC books it ('SG' = the Singapore hub). `Product`: 'Import LC', 'Export LC', 'Guarantee / SBLC', 'Documentary Collection', 'Trade Loan', 'Receivables Purchase'.
- Counts: `Transactions` = instruments ISSUED in the period (a flow); `Live Instruments` = instruments outstanding at the month-end (e.g. the number of live guarantees); `Active Trade Clients` counts clients. Pricing = `Fee Yield bps`; carbon exposure = `Is Carbon-Intensive Commodity`.
- Return ratios, shares and growth exactly as the measures give them - fractions (0.37 = 37%), never multiplied by 100. Corridor market growth = `Corridor Growth YoY %` with `Corridor Volume USD` and `Corridor Volume Prior Year USD` on the later period (it compares the same months a year earlier).
- Keep NULL groups: never add `IS NOT NULL` filters on grouping columns unless asked (a NULL `Segment` / `Is Japanese Corporate` is an unclassified trade client). Japanese vs non-Japanese = GROUP BY `Is Japanese Corporate` itself (true / false / null), not a CASE label. Only add LIMIT for a top N.
- SCF limit / utilisation are programme-level (never split by supplier fields); `Utilisation Band` = 'Above 85%', '40-85%', 'Below 40%'; the anchor buyer is `Client`. Discrepancy counts by `Discrepancy Type` need `Is Discrepant`; rising-discrepancy clients = `Is Client Discrepancy Rising`; payment-visible clients with no trade product = `Is Payment Visible` AND NOT `Has Trade Product Today`.
- `Client Group` has a value dictionary: filter it with = on the exact name; entity questions list `Client`. Functions (STRING arguments): SCF anchor candidates = smbc_genie.gold.fn_scf_anchor_candidates('50'); the N fastest-growing corridors = fn_trade_corridor_growth('FY2026-H1', '20000000', '10'); one group's trade profile by entity = fn_trade_group_profile('<exact group name>').
- Answer with one summary sentence that states the period and filters used, then the table. In the SQL keep every value unscaled and unrounded - ratios, shares and growth stay fractions (never * 100); name output columns plainly.
sample_questions: Which trade corridors grew trade finance issuance fastest in H1 FY2026 vs H1 FY2025?
What is our import LC volume into Vietnam and India by commodity and client segment this fiscal year?
How are our SCF programmes utilised by anchor, and which are above 85% or below 40%?
What is the LC document discrepancy rate by booking country this fiscal year, and which clients have a rising discrepancy rate from H2 FY2025 to H1 FY2026?
What is the median trade-operations turnaround by product and country versus the 24-hour SLA?
Which clients trade in the CN->VN electronics corridor (visible from payments) but have no trade product with us?
Which buyers paying 50 or more distinct suppliers through us could anchor a new SCF programme?
How has our trade exposure to carbon-intensive commodities trended by quarter?

trusted_queries.name: SCF programme utilisation and supplier activation by anchor at the end of :month
trusted_queries.usage_guidance: Use for "SCF programme health", "utilisation by anchor", "programmes above 85% or below 40%", "supplier onboarding / activation by programme".
trusted_queries.sql:
SELECT `Programme`, `Client` AS anchor, `Anchor Country`, `Utilisation Band`,
       MEASURE(`Programme Limit USD`)      AS programme_limit_usd,
       MEASURE(`Financed Outstanding USD`) AS financed_outstanding_usd,
       MEASURE(`Utilisation %`)            AS utilisation,
       MEASURE(`Suppliers in Register`)    AS suppliers_in_register,
       MEASURE(`Suppliers Onboarded`)      AS suppliers_onboarded,
       MEASURE(`Suppliers Active`)         AS suppliers_active,
       MEASURE(`Supplier Activation %`)    AS supplier_activation_rate
FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_tb_scf
WHERE `Month` = :month
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY utilisation DESC

trusted_queries.name: Trade finance issuance by product in :fiscal_half vs :prior_fiscal_half and the growth
trusted_queries.usage_guidance: Use for "issuance by product half on half / year on year", "H1 FY2026 vs H1 FY2025 by product", "which trade products are growing"; for corridors use fn_trade_corridor_growth.
trusted_queries.sql:
WITH h AS (
  SELECT `Product`, `Fiscal Half`, MEASURE(`Issuance USD`) AS issuance_usd
  FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_tb_trade_finance
  WHERE `Fiscal Half` IN (:prior_fiscal_half, :fiscal_half)
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT `Product`,
       sum(CASE WHEN `Fiscal Half` = :prior_fiscal_half THEN issuance_usd END) AS issuance_prior_half_usd,
       sum(CASE WHEN `Fiscal Half` = :fiscal_half THEN issuance_usd END) AS issuance_half_usd,
       sum(CASE WHEN `Fiscal Half` = :fiscal_half THEN issuance_usd END)
         / sum(CASE WHEN `Fiscal Half` = :prior_fiscal_half THEN issuance_usd END) - 1 AS issuance_growth_yoy
FROM h GROUP BY `Product`
ORDER BY issuance_growth_yoy DESC

trusted_queries.name: Clients flagged with a rising LC discrepancy rate and their discrepancy rate in :prior_fiscal_half and :fiscal_half
trusted_queries.usage_guidance: Use for "clients with a rising / deteriorating discrepancy rate", "discrepancy trend by client", "early-warning input from trade documents".
trusted_queries.sql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT `Client`, `Fiscal Half`, MEASURE(`Discrepancy Rate %`) AS discrepancy_rate
  FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_trade_operations
  WHERE `Is Client Discrepancy Rising` AND `Fiscal Half` IN (:prior_fiscal_half, :fiscal_half)
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT `Client`,
       max(CASE WHEN `Fiscal Half` = :prior_fiscal_half THEN discrepancy_rate END) AS discrepancy_rate_prior_half,
       max(CASE WHEN `Fiscal Half` = :fiscal_half THEN discrepancy_rate END) AS discrepancy_rate_half
FROM r GROUP BY `Client`
ORDER BY discrepancy_rate_half - discrepancy_rate_prior_half DESC

trusted_queries.name: Anchor-buyer candidates for new SCF programmes - buyers paying at least 50 distinct suppliers through us since :from_month that are not already an SCF anchor
trusted_queries.usage_guidance: Use for "SCF anchor candidates / prospects", "buyers with 50+ suppliers", "who could anchor a supplier finance programme"; a payments CTE anti-joined to the SCF anchors (metric views cannot be joined directly).
trusted_queries.sql:
WITH sup AS (
  SELECT `Client`, `Segment`, `Coverage Office`,
         MEASURE(`Distinct Suppliers Paid`) AS distinct_suppliers_paid,
         MEASURE(`Payment Volume USD`)      AS supplier_payments_usd
  FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_tb_payments
  WHERE `Month` >= :from_month AND `Direction` = 'Outbound' AND `Payment Purpose` = 'Supplier'
  GROUP BY ALL
), anchors AS (
  SELECT `Client`, MEASURE(`Programmes`) AS programmes
  FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_tb_scf
  WHERE `Is Latest Month`
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT s.`Client`, s.`Segment`, s.`Coverage Office`, s.distinct_suppliers_paid, s.supplier_payments_usd
FROM sup s LEFT ANTI JOIN anchors a ON a.`Client` = s.`Client`
WHERE s.distinct_suppliers_paid >= 50
ORDER BY s.supplier_payments_usd DESC

trusted_queries.name: Trade outstanding in carbon-intensive commodities at each fiscal quarter-end since :from_quarter, and its share of total outstanding
trusted_queries.usage_guidance: Use for "carbon-intensive / high-carbon trade exposure trend", "transition-risk commodities by quarter", "brown commodity share of the trade book".
trusted_queries.sql:
WITH q AS (
  SELECT `Fiscal Quarter`, `Is Carbon-Intensive Commodity`, MEASURE(`Outstanding USD`) AS outstanding_usd
  FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_tb_trade_finance
  WHERE `Fiscal Quarter` >= :from_quarter
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT `Fiscal Quarter`,
       sum(CASE WHEN `Is Carbon-Intensive Commodity` THEN outstanding_usd END) AS carbon_intensive_outstanding_usd,
       sum(outstanding_usd) AS total_outstanding_usd,
       sum(CASE WHEN `Is Carbon-Intensive Commodity` THEN outstanding_usd END) / sum(outstanding_usd) AS carbon_intensive_share
FROM q GROUP BY `Fiscal Quarter`
ORDER BY `Fiscal Quarter`

trusted_queries.name: Import LCs into Vietnam and India of electronics and auto parts from China, Korea and Japan - :fiscal_half vs :prior_fiscal_half, growth and the share booked in Singapore
trusted_queries.usage_guidance: Use for "VN / IN import surge", "electronics and auto-parts import LCs into Vietnam and India", "how much of the surge is booked in the Singapore hub".
trusted_queries.sql:
WITH h AS (
  SELECT `Fiscal Half`, `Booking Country`, MEASURE(`Transactions`) AS import_lcs
  FROM smbc_genie.metrics.mv_tb_trade_finance
  WHERE `Fiscal Half` IN (:prior_fiscal_half, :fiscal_half) AND `Product` = 'Import LC'
    AND `Corridor To` IN ('VN', 'IN') AND `Corridor From` IN ('CN', 'KR', 'JP')
    AND `Commodity` IN ('Electronics', 'Auto Parts')
  GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT sum(CASE WHEN `Fiscal Half` = :fiscal_half THEN import_lcs END) AS import_lcs_half,
       sum(CASE WHEN `Fiscal Half` = :prior_fiscal_half THEN import_lcs END) AS import_lcs_prior_half,
       sum(CASE WHEN `Fiscal Half` = :fiscal_half THEN import_lcs END)
         / sum(CASE WHEN `Fiscal Half` = :prior_fiscal_half THEN import_lcs END) - 1 AS import_lc_growth_yoy,
       sum(CASE WHEN `Fiscal Half` = :fiscal_half AND `Booking Country` = 'SG' THEN import_lcs END)
         / sum(CASE WHEN `Fiscal Half` = :fiscal_half THEN import_lcs END) AS share_booked_in_singapore
FROM h
